name: Hardening Polish
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot —; Price 1,000 gp; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

Useful to those encountering heavily armored clockwork guardians and formidable golems, this unguent, when applied to a melee weapon, hardens its edge and strengthens the material for a brief period. Once applied, it gives the weapon or material the properties of adamantine for 10 rounds before wearing off. A vial of hardening polish coats a single melee weapon or 20 units of ammunition.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Cost 500 gp
